system.description:
Tropical forest high above the ground, crowded with life. Bridges and platforms hang among the branches, and the forest floor is a long fall away. People stay in constant call with each other and notice every movement around them.

Talent: one Wit die to d10, one Presence die to d10.

  • Warding Chant. You learn the Warding Chant Technique: Sonic, +1 to one Skill of choice, chosen allies within Near (Selective).
  • Wide Sight. +2 Training in Acuity.
